prompt:
Create a NEW KFB claymation ink-blob sheet using the two attached original benchmarks solely for anatomy, clay surface, and sculpted eyes. Exactly six complete independent footless characters in three columns by two rows. Landscape 1536×1024 PNG. TRUE transparent alpha-zero background in all gaps and margins. No white matte, floor, vignette, scenery, large backdrop screens, shadow discs, labels, grid lines, real organization logos or national badges. Dangerous Card Containment crew. Shared kit: indigo fabric collar rings, bone-white ceramic helmet rims, black smoked displays and dusty lilac fasteners, portable retro bureau equipment. Top row Capture Detail, bottom row Archive Detail. Each blob is a separate character with a full standalone silhouette at comparable scale. Art direction: richly tactile dark charcoal-plum satin clay with soft highlights, round organic goo bodies and short goo hands. Equipment rests directly against the clay body with chunky rounded shapes. Keep each full face unobstructed, including white ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, dark sculpted lids and dark ink lips. Protective hoods have wide open face rings or a clear visor raised above the forehead. Two subtly female-read figures in cells 2 and 5. Mouth and body silhouette vary deliberately. Teeth sit within an open mouth. No human torso, legs, boots or rigid armor. Props: a Hypernormalization Screen is a little portable slab the character holds beside its body, with dark smoked glass and a chunky rim. A dangerous card is a sealed abstract blank card with one tiny dark corner mark. No lettering. Keep all silhouettes including droplets and equipment in their cells, with generous air around each. Row-major direction:
1. Male-read coldly attentive screen operator. compact handheld Hypernormalization Screen with bone frame, indigo fittings and smoked glass facing outward. tall narrow blob, tense side glance.
2. Female-read curiously guarded card capturer. sealed translucent sleeve holding one blank card with an abstract dark corner mark. round soft crest, sharp unequal eyes.
3. Male-read dryly irritated perimeter guard. closed indigo latch box with thick ceramic hinge. wide box-rounded blob, frown and heavy lids.
4. Male-read serenely methodical archive custodian. small upright case with a visible blank card in its clear lid. squat broad blob, closed unsettling smile.
5. Female-read intently focused screen technician. second smaller Hypernormalization Screen with bone casing, dark inset and lilac corner bumpers. tall crescent blob, uneven raised brow.
6. Male-read uneasily composed evidence courier. small closed card cassette with two ceramic latches. pear blob, large wary eyes and forced crooked smile.
Make the theme readable at thumbnail size. Render all six as independent character cutouts with true alpha.
